g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Users connect to the global HTTPS load balancer
The URL map sends page requests to the backend bucket, which serves the React site from Cloud Storage
and API requests to the backend service, where Cloud Armor filters attacks
The managed instance group spreads requests across two zones
The API checks Memorystore for cached results
The autoscaler on the regional managed instance group targets 60% average CPU: above it, the group adds VMs spread evenly across both zones, up to ten
below it, the group removes VMs, never fewer than two
Autohealing recreates any VM that fails the health check
